sentences.en: I have made it my life's mission to eradicate malaria.
sentences.zh: 我将根除疟疾作为一生的使命。

sentences.en: A concerted effort is required to eradicate malaria in the country.
sentences.zh: 该国需要共同努力来根除疟疾。

sentences.en: He contracted malaria while living in the jungle.
sentences.zh: 他在丛林生活时感染了疟疾。
